title: Heavenly Syrian Tofu Tagine
description: A fresh, silky, energizing Syrian tofu tagine featuring colatura di alici and a poached vegetable medley.
instructions: Rinse and press the tofu to remove excess moisture, then cut into 1-inch cubes.
Heat the tagine pot over medium heat and drizzle olive oil, letting it coat the bottom.
Add the tofu cubes to the pot and sauté until lightly golden on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the diced red bell pepper, sliced zucchini, and halved cherry tomatoes, cooking until the vegetables begin to soften, about 4 minutes.
Sprinkle cumin, coriander, paprika, and salt over the mixture, stirring to coat evenly.
Pour in the lemon juice and colatura di alici, then add enough water to just cover the ingredients, about 200ml.
Bring the liquid to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the pot, letting the tagine simmer for 25 minutes.
Check the seasoning, adjusting salt or spices as desired; the tofu should be tender and the flavors melded.
Stir in freshly chopped parsley just before serving, allowing it to wilt slightly.
Serve the heavenly Syrian tofu tagine hot, accompanied by lime wedges or a side of gluten-free couscous if desired.
